label: Modeling a constraint
subgoals: Fit a separate model to the constrained quantity
Standardize the gap between its posterior mean and the specification
Read the feasibility probability from the normal distribution

label: Constrained expected improvement
subgoals: Compute EI of the objective against the best feasible value
Compute the probability that every constraint holds
Multiply the two for the constrained acquisition

label: The feasible incumbent
subgoals: Discard runs that violate any specification
Take the best objective among the remaining runs
Search for feasibility first when no run qualifies
